DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a mother with non-protective rubella antibodies, prematurity, and the infant's presentation of apnea (likely due to pulmonary artery stenosis) and anemia (due to thrombocytopenia and anemia of the congenital rubella syndrome) strongly points to this diagnosis. I am requesting a confirmatory test and imaging.
